fact: ISOC Pulse, from self-reported PeeringDB data, lists the Togo Internet Exchange Point (TGIX) in Lomé with 9 member ASNs and 18 Gbps cumulative port capacity, 7 of 9 peering at the route server, one ASN joined and none left in the last 12 months.
TGIX members registered outside Togo include PCH (two ASNs, United States), and GVA (Côte d'Ivoire), per ISOC Pulse/PeeringDB; 6 of 9 members are registered in Togo.

Lomé Data Centre's own home page lists a local Internet Exchange Point among its connectivity features and peering among its interconnection services; it does not name the exchange or give members. As_of is the page date.
system: Local Internet Exchange Point (Lomé Data Centre)
